payload.annual_classification: Restricted-policy retrospective conditional replay:298mandatory cash days, at most67active calendar days, one200dollar account without deposits or monthly resets. A complete path under these restrictions is not a full-year market-opportunity audit, an ex-post best policy, or a rewrite ofE023. Separate free/reserved cash, open principal, cost-basis equity and unavailable liquidation value; do not credit after-year settlements at year-end.
limitations: Costed and stress use an assumed0.07quadratic coefficient with aggregate cent rounding on entry and sale; settlement no transaction fee. This is not contemporaneous fee evidence and must remain labeled a sensitivity assumption.

Quotes are exact later candle bid/ask endpoints, with no carried values, midpoint fills, OHLC extremes, or volume-derived fills. Use an explicitly assumed100contract cap, original limit at decision, aggregate integer-order fees and source receipts actually acquired inSeptember2026. Assumed historical endpoint availability is unverified; verified mode must refuse it. A cash regime blocks only new decisions and preserves prior orders, holdings, exits, limits and drawdown.

No October-December2025 prices, outcomes, settlements or derived features are opened. The cash-only prefix is explicitly part of this new restricted policy. No change to original validation, holdout-release or promotion law.

normalization_revision.interpretation: Exactly four pinned categorical No strings corroborate official no results only; they are not numeric temperatures. Preserve raw values, full census and all numeric contradiction checks. Empty/None behavior unchanged. Other nonnumeric/nonfinite values remain errors.

payload.training_audit_status: A separate full-ledger audit is required; full accounts and linked immutable intents are retained.

account.conservative_marking: Cash plus cancellable reservations; all unresolved held contracts marked zero, irrespective of known future labels.
account.cost_marking: Cash plus cancellable order reservations plus open purchase principal; fees expensed immediately. This is bookkeeping at cost, not liquidation equity.
account.fee_assumption: Supplied quadratic coefficients; one aggregate fill per entry/exit, account rounding applied to total debit/credit. No historical fee claim is inferred.
account.same_timestamp_order: Releases, then decisions ordered by trade_id, then entries ordered by trade_id.

schedule_metadata.switch_behavior: New decisions use their effective policy and fraction; prior reservations, holdings, exits, fees, exposure and drawdown persist.

account.startup: Starts flat; decisions before start are excluded, with no inherited positions or orders.
